# `xml_attribute_indent`

Where an attribute on a line of its own starts. Unset keeps its offset from its element as written.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `single_indent` |  |
| `double_indent` |  |
| `align_by_first_attribute` |  |

**Default:** `(not set)`

Unset, an attribute on a line of its own keeps its offset from its element, so attributes aligned under the first one stay aligned when the element is re-indented. A value's own continuation lines never move.

### `xml_attribute_indent = single_indent`

```ini
xml_attribute_indent = single_indent
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```xml
<Project>
    <Target Name="Pack"
            DependsOnTargets="Build"
            Condition="'$(IsPackable)' == 'true'">
    </Target>
</Project>
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```xml
<Project>
  <Target Name="Pack"
    DependsOnTargets="Build"
    Condition="'$(IsPackable)' == 'true'">
  </Target>
</Project>
```
:::

::::
